title.narrative: JSB2025_Northeast Reset Fostering Stabilisation and Resilience for Early Transition of Communities Affected by Extremist Violence and Climate Change in Northeast Nigeria

description.narrative: Communities in Borno State, Northeast Nigeria, continue to recover from the prolonged impacts of the Boko Haram insurgency, compounded by climate shocks and economic fragility. While stabilization interventions under the Regional Stabilization Facility (RSF) have improved security, restored basic services, and reactivated community structures, many households and local economies remain vulnerable due to limited livelihood opportunities, low productivity, and weak systems for sustaining community investments. Building directly on RSF gains, the project consolidates recovery outcomes by strengthening economic and environmental resilience and improving access to inclusive, gender-responsive basic services in conflict- and disaster-prone communities. Under Output 1, the project will rehabilitate and solarise the Muna Vocational Training Centre in Maiduguri benefiting at least 400 women and youth annually to deliver market relevant vocational training and operations and maintenance skills, while upgrading the capacities of 100 women and youth (50 female, 50 male) previously supported under stabilization through enhanced skills training and start-up packages, and strengthening local businesses using the Kaizen approach. Under Output 2, the project will construct or rehabilitate a gender-responsive community wellness centre providing integrated mental health and psychosocial support, referrals, and community dialogue, and will strengthen access to justice through gender-responsive legal aid and community-based paralegal services, directly targeting 150 beneficiaries, at least 60 of whom are women. Implementation will leverage existing stabilization platforms, particularly Community Stabilization Committees (CSCs), and work in close coordination with state institutions and private sector actors to improve incomes, enhance food security, reinforce social cohesion, and reduce the risk of relapse into instability.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
